what: The Atelier's reading of how each of the six repeatable tests on control that hold their result brings about the behaviour it measures (handoff ho-2026-11-19-atelier-1), carried as the Atelier coded it; only these fields are carried. Its rule, fixed before reading: 'trained' (the testers trained it in), 'told' (an instruction asked for it), 'asked' (the model was asked a question or a request and its answer is the result), 'untold' (nobody asked for it and it was observed in use).
